Methodology documentation (43 pp.) for the GMT 2026 data files already extracted as iea_2026_methane-tracker-abatement (same source-id iea_2026_004). Page numbers are printed (PAGE | n footers) and equal PDF pages. Loaded: Table 11 (p.27) coal mine methane abatement costs for a typical US mine - capital cost (USD million), operational cost (USD million, taken as annual), lifetime - for six measures, with the Table 10 effectiveness factor as emissions-reduction-potential, plus the drained-CMM-utilisation sizing (2.5 MW, 75% capacity factor, 2.5 kt CH4/yr; derived 2,040 USD/kW incl. drainage system). Other-values: Table 10 applicability and abatement potentials, Table 9 emission splits, cost scalers, 2025 US electricity and coal prices, methane conversions and the well-head gas price rule. Not loaded: Table 8 (p.22) lists the oil and gas abatement options by name only (no numbers; their costs are in the open-source model, iea_2026_005); LDAR percentages (p.23) duplicate the model; emissions-estimation chapters (country/sector totals, not technology-level). PRICE YEAR: no dollar year printed; 2025_USD adopted (2025 energy prices, WEO 2025 capital costs) - flag. The same decision relabelled iea_2026_004 abatement costs from 2026_USD to 2025_USD on 2026-10-07.
